title: tapper keg schema definition
description: Schema for documents stored as schemas/<type>.schema.yaml in a keg.

version.description: Optional schema document version reserved for future migrations.

type.description: Node type governed by this schema. Must match the edited schema type name.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what this schema validates.

meta.description: JSON Schema object applied to node metadata/frontmatter.

markdown.description: Markdown structure rules applied to node content.

requireTitle.description: Require the markdown body to contain an H1 title.

ordered.description: Require listed sections to appear in declaration order.

required.description: Whether this section must be present.

relations.description: Relation requirements for links from nodes of this type.

type.description: Target node type for this relation.

direction.description: Whether the relation is satisfied by outgoing links or incoming backlinks. Defaults to links.

required.description: Whether at least one matching relation must exist.

attribute.description: Target-node metadata attribute used for omega scoring.

weight.description: Positive omega weight for this relation rule.

enum.description: Enum metadata values mapped to omega scores from 0 to 1.
